hypotheses.mechanism_summary: Stablecoins are the settlement rail of crypto trading.
hypotheses.timeframes: 1d bars; decision evaluated weekly at Sunday 23:00:00 UTC; execution at the next daily bar open (Monday 00:00 UTC)

estimated_turnover.basis: pre-measurement estimate from the rule's design (weekly decisions, 30-day growth versus its 365-day median)
estimated_turnover.note: the drag is computed in PREREGISTRATION_MANIFEST.json from the frozen cost model; realised turnover is measured in Phase B and may not be tuned

reviewed_against_closed_lines: spot-BTC ETF net-flow continuation (closed): different mechanism (stablecoin primary issuance, not ETF creations) and a different data source; the ETF-flow line was falsified as a trend proxy, which this spec's trend baseline will test again

stablecoin exchange-flow prediction (OPP-0003, WATCH not closed): this hypothesis is not the 1-2h exchange-flow construction; it uses a free aggregate series at a cost-compatible horizon and keeps OPP-0003's reopen conditions in view

hypotheses.mechanism_summary: Bitcoin trades as a long-duration, dollar-liquidity-sensitive risk asset.
hypotheses.timeframes: 1d bars; decision evaluated weekly at Sunday 23:00:00 UTC; execution at the next daily bar open (Monday 00:00 UTC)

estimated_turnover.basis: pre-measurement estimate from the rule's design (weekly decisions, 4-week net-liquidity change sign)
estimated_turnover.note: the drag is computed in PREREGISTRATION_MANIFEST.json from the frozen cost model; realised turnover is measured in Phase B and may not be tuned

reviewed_against_closed_lines: time-series momentum / trend (closed): the signal is a macro accounting identity, not a price transform; the 200-day trend baseline is the frozen camera that detects a trend re-description
funding carry (closed): no basis, no perpetual leg, no funding cashflow

hypotheses.mechanism_summary: Miners are structurally forced sellers of BTC: their revenues are in BTC and their costs are in fiat.
hypotheses.timeframes: 1d bars; daily decision at bar close; execution at the next bar open

estimated_turnover.basis: observed event frequency of hash-ribbon episodes in the available daily hashrate history (2018-10 to 2026-10)
estimated_turnover.note: at this frequency a sealed forward window of 24 months can accumulate at most a handful of closed round trips, far below the campaign's preregistered 20-trip floor

reviewed_against_closed_lines: no closed line matches a hashrate/supply-side mechanism; retained, not admitted
hypotheses.non_admission_reason: NOT ADMITTED in Discovery 2: the rule's event frequency (1-4 round trips per year) cannot support the campaign's preregistered sample floor of 20 sealed out-of-sample round trips within 24 months, so the campaign could not reach a PASS or FAIL verdict on it; its historical window (daily resolution) also covers only two cycles. It is retained with its observation rule so that it can be re-proposed when the forward hashrate record and any future information source give it a feasible design. Admitting it now would spend one of the three campaign slots on a design that is foreknown to return INSUFFICIENT_OOS_SAMPLE.

rejected_before_admission.mechanism: Google Trends search attention predicts BTC returns (investor attention factor)
rejected_before_admission.reason: the Trend index is recomputed retroactively by the vendor, so historical values are not PIT-reproducible and a strict PIT audit cannot pass; forward-only collection would postpone any result beyond the campaign window

rejected_before_admission.mechanism: stablecoin exchange net-inflow prediction at the 1-2h horizon (OPP-0003)
rejected_before_admission.reason: labelled exchange-flow history is commercial and the source's horizon is below the cost floor (reopen condition in OPP-0003 unmet)
realized-cap history requires a paid provider; no free verifiable series with PIT publication semantics was identified in Phase A

rejected_before_admission.mechanism: Deribit DVOL implied-volatility risk premium timing
rejected_before_admission.reason: the tradeable expression (options) is outside the certified runtime and the spot-only expression reduces to a volatility-shock signal, a family already closed by ALPHA-001 F5

rejected_before_admission.mechanism: quarterly futures roll / expiry basis convergence
rejected_before_admission.reason: same basis-carry family already rejected (OPP-0008/0030); no free historical quarterly contract series with verified provenance in the repository

rejected_before_admission.mechanism: Bitcoin network adoption (active addresses / NVT) valuation
rejected_before_admission.reason: active-address series are sensitive to chain heuristics and vendor revisions; no versioned, PIT-pinned source identified; overlaps Metcalfe-style valuation claims that are not falsifiable at daily frequency

note: admission is not validation and not a profitability claim
